description: eJournalPress (EJP) used by American Chemical Society (ACS), American Society for Microbiology (ASM), and ASBMB journals.
step_by_step: 1. Create account at ejpress.org or pubs.acs.org (ACS Paragon Plus)
5. Upload cover letter as separate PDF
6. Upload figures: TIFF at 600 dpi (halftone) or 1200 dpi (line art)
7. Upload supporting information as single PDF (SI.pdf) or individual files
common_errors: Figure resolution < 600 dpi → system warns; editors may request re-upload
SI uploaded as multiple unlabelled files → confuses editors

file_requirements.figures: TIFF (600+ dpi halftone, 1200+ dpi line art) or EPS
